title: Definitive Meta-Analysis of RAMA/CAMA Across 12 Experiments (Iterations 2–4)
summary: Demo notebook for a definitive meta-analysis of RAMA/CAMA across 12 experiments (iterations 2-4). Loads 23 pre-extracted task results with raw seed values from mini_demo_data.json, then runs 5 analysis phases: (A) evidence quality grading (GREEN/YELLOW/RED), (B) per-task Cohen's d with 10k bootstrap CIs, (C) DerSimonian-Laird random-effects meta-analysis across 4 subgroups, (D) 6 critical diagnostics (val-test inflation, classification vs regression, Amazon stability, gate learning, degenerate baselines, Avito safety), and (E) a 7-dimension publication readiness scorecard. Visualization includes a forest plot with pooled estimates and a radar chart scorecard. Full original parameters (N_BOOTSTRAP=10,000) run in ~2 minutes.
